# Requirements Quality Checklist: SafeRoute AI - Safety-Aware Navigation

**Purpose**: Reviewer checklist validating the quality, clarity, completeness, and consistency of the SafeRoute AI requirements across API, security/privacy, performance/reliability, scoring/data model, and UX. This tests the requirements writing, not the implementation.
**Created**: 2026-10-09
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) | [plan.md](../plan.md) | [data-model.md](../data-model.md) | [contracts/openapi.yaml](../contracts/openapi.yaml)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## API Contract & Integration Requirements

- [ ] CHK001 Are error response shapes specified for all failure modes (invalid input, unresolvable location, upstream outage)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, §Contracts]
- [ ] CHK002 Is the request schema (origin, destination, preference) fully specified with required/optional fields and length bounds? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001, §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK003 Are timeouts and failure behavior defined for each external dependency (routing, geocoding, LLM)? [Coverage, Gap, research R9]
- [ ] CHK004 Are HTTP status-code requirements consistent across all endpoints (400/404/502)? [Consistency, Spec §Contracts]
- [ ] CHK005 Is API versioning or backward-compatibility addressed or explicitly excluded? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK006 Are the imagery-coverage and assessed-flag response fields traceable to a stated requirement? [Traceability, Spec §FR-019]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the behavior specified when the routing service returns only a single route? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Security & Privacy Requirements

- [ ] CHK008 Are requirements defined for keeping API keys/secrets out of client-visible artifacts? [Completeness, Gap]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the query-log retention period quantified and testable? [Clarity, Spec §FR-020]
- [ ] CHK010 Is "personal data" defined, including what may be shared with third-party routing/LLM services? [Clarity, Spec §FR-020]
- [ ] CHK011 Is the purge trigger for expired logs specified (startup vs per-request)? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-020]
- [ ] CHK012 Are input-validation and sanitization requirements defined at trust boundaries? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK013 Is location-history exposure addressed via a documented threat or abuse scenario? [Gap]

## Performance & Reliability Requirements

- [ ] CHK014 Is the latency target quantified with a percentile and trip bounds? [Clarity, Spec §SC-001]
- [ ] CHK015 Are performance requirements under concurrent load specified or explicitly excluded? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK016 Are degradation requirements specified for each external-service failure class? [Completeness, Spec §SC-008]
- [ ] CHK017 Is caching behavior (what is cached, invalidation) stated in requirements rather than left implicit? [Ambiguity, research R10]
- [ ] CHK018 Are availability/uptime expectations stated or explicitly out of scope? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK019 Are observability requirements (latency/failure logging) defined? [Coverage, Gap]

## Scoring & Data Model Requirements

- [ ] CHK020 Is the Safety Score formula fully specified, including the decay factor and its default value? [Clarity, Spec §FR-008, §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK021 Is the treatment of unassessed segments in the score average unambiguous? [Clarity, Spec §FR-019]
- [ ] CHK022 Is the imagery staleness cutoff quantified and configurable? [Clarity, Spec §FR-018]
- [ ] CHK023 Are severity levels and their effect on hazard cost defined? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007, §FR-008]
- [ ] CHK024 Are hazard class weights documented as prototype values with their justification? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK025 Are entity constraints (value ranges, enums, required fields) specified for every entity? [Completeness, data-model]
- [ ] CHK026 Is the ranking formula specified, including normalization of the time term? [Clarity, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK027 Is "higher means safer" applied consistently across score, ranking, and coverage semantics? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009, §FR-019]

## UX & Accessibility Requirements

- [ ] CHK028 Are empty, loading, and error states specified for the route-search flow? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK029 Are requirements defined for presenting partially-assessed routes to the user? [Completeness, Spec §FR-019, §SC-009]
- [ ] CHK030 Are accessibility requirements (keyboard, screen reader, contrast) specified or explicitly excluded? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK031 Is the presentation of the explanation and hazard locations specified with sufficient clarity? [Clarity, Spec §FR-014, §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK032 Are localization/units requirements (distance, time, language) defined or excluded? [Gap]
- [ ] CHK033 Is the presentation when routes tie on score and time specified? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK034 Are requirements defined for all identified edge cases (single route, missing imagery, garbled preference, unreachable destination)? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK035 Are preference-interpretation failure and its balanced-default behavior unambiguous? [Clarity, Spec §FR-015]
- [ ] CHK036 Are very-long-route / many-segment scenarios addressed or bounded? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK037 Is the "zero assessed segments" recommendation rule testable and free of conflicts? [Measurability, Spec §FR-019]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK038 Are external dependency requirements (routing returns alternatives, LLM returns valid JSON) documented and validated? [Dependency, Spec §Assumptions, research R1/R7]
- [ ] CHK039 Are hazard-detector accuracy/generalization limits documented as assumptions? [Assumption, Spec §Assumptions]

## Traceability & Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] CHK040 Is a requirement/success-criteria ID scheme established and are criteria traceable to it? [Traceability]
- [ ] CHK041 Are all success criteria measurable and technology-agnostic? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001..§SC-011]

## Notes

- Items marked incomplete require spec updates before proceeding; this checklist reviews requirement quality only.
- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied.
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation.
- `/speckit.implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers.
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit.specify` and `/speckit.clarify`.
- Add comments or findings inline and link to relevant resources.
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference.
